shared_elements: representation of a body/figure in stone relief or sculpture
justification: The only shared content is the presence of an anthropomorphic head/face; A shows a detailed narrative relief with a horse-drawn chariot, a driver, a procession of robed dignitaries in profile with staffs and vessels, stepped crenellations and rosette borders, while B is a single crude, frontal, three-dimensional figure with a bulging round face, grimacing toothed head above and stumpy limbs. There is no correspondence in composition, relationships or rendering conventions: A is a linear, low-relief, profile-based, register-organized scheme, B is a blocky frontal idol with schematic, almost featureless anatomy.
